descriptions.backlog_count: Number of active failed/uncleared course backlogs

descriptions.credits_completed_ratio: Proportion of attempted degree credits successfully earned
descriptions.stress_level_score: Self-reported psychological stress metric from voluntary survey (1 - 10)
descriptions.quiz_average_score: Average continuous assessment and quiz examination score

descriptions.social_belonging_score: Institutional sense of belonging and community integration score (1 - 10)
descriptions.commute_time_minutes: One-way commute duration to campus in minutes
descriptions.lms_logins_per_week: Weekly interactions and logins on learning management portal
descriptions.forum_participation_count: Number of contributions, questions, and replies on course forums
descriptions.library_checkouts: Number of library volumes or digital monograph checkouts
descriptions.video_watch_ratio: Ratio of assigned digital instructional video content completed
descriptions.sleep_hours_per_day: Self-reported average nightly sleep duration in hours
descriptions.repeated_courses_count: Number of curriculum subjects currently being repeated
descriptions.current_semester: Current academic semester of study (1 to 8)
descriptions.parental_education_level: Highest educational attainment level of parents/guardians
descriptions.family_income_bracket: Socio-economic household income category (Low, Medium, High)
